blind_freeze_order: verify all frozen input, release, baseline-result, Demucs executable, runner, and checkpoint authorities
execute configuration B twice in independent fresh processes and freeze each complete four-stem population
execute configuration C twice in independent fresh processes and freeze each complete four-stem population
classify byte replay independently for B and C without selecting or averaging runs
execute unchanged canonical JGA v0.3.0-alpha independently on drums.wav and bass.wav from every frozen run
freeze all four JGA reports before accessing complete original-stem event and relation records
score Level-1, Level-2, and Level-3 independently twice using the previously frozen rules
require exact scoring replay and only then apply the prospective Phase-1 decision gate

decision_gate.alternative_model_gate: Alternative models require separate PI approval and prospective checkpoint/checksum authority after Phase-1 review.
decision_gate.indeterminate: If results fall between the improvement and persistence definitions, report MIXED_OR_INDETERMINATE and stop for scientific review.
decision_gate.material_improvement_signal: A candidate configuration supplies a material Bass-population improvement signal only when BOTH fresh runs exceed the best frozen baseline run for matched count (>625), recall (>0.5924170616113744), and F1 (>0.7212925562608193), while reducing original-only count below 430. Timing metrics are reported but cannot compensate for failure of these population conditions.
decision_gate.persistent_severe_deficit_signal: The severe deficit substantially persists if EVERY B/C run has recall <=0.5924170616113744 and absolute Bass EME count deficit >=377. This does not establish that Demucs is unsuitable; it only supports PI review of a separately preregistered model comparison.
decision_gate.stop_after_improvement: If either B or C meets the material-improvement signal, stop for scientific review before any alternative-model work.

ad038: mapped nearest/predecessor/follower identity stability through the frozen Bass and Drum Level-2 mappings
level_3_contract.rule: Reuse the exact frozen Level-3 comparison in EXEC-CEDVAL006-CONTROLLED-MIX-SEPARATION-JGA-ROBUSTNESS-01; temporal geometry is not musical correspondence.
